# The Tarot Almanac

> The Tarot Almanac is a deterministic tarot reading app that assigns fixed cards to dates and birthdays via tarot numerology.

The Tarot Almanac is the astro.com of tarot: every date resolves to fixed cards through modular arithmetic, not shuffling or chance. A birth date always maps to the same cards, and every calendar day carries its own fixed collective and personal cards.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/): overview of the deterministic tarot-numerology system.
- [How It Works](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/how-it-works): the math and method behind the fixed-card system.
- [Pricing](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/pricing): subscription and one-off chart pricing.
- [Tarot Birth Card](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/tarot-birth-card): calculate your tarot birth card from your birthday.
- [Tarot Birth Chart](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/tarot-birth-chart): full natal tarot birth chart.
- [The Tarot Almanac vs. Raka](https://www.tarotalmanac.com/vs/raka): how The Tarot Almanac compares to Raka.
